revision.name: single-row-spacing-20261003-a1
revision.decision: New user-directed single-row round; not a two-row repair allowance.

layout.method: Generate each real open_pdks PCell, transform its exact native rectangles into one flat Magic cell, then route with native Magic metal and open_pdks via generators.

balanced_outputs.limitation: Attached qp M2 stubs match mirrored metal extent, not series resistance. Report series paths and stubs separately; output M3 tracks remain at different heights.

ground_shields.connection: Two real M4 spines join all three M3 shields to the existing VSS M3 bus through eight actual open_pdks via3 cells.

routing.description: Same single-row pair order/mirroring/y, guarded native PCells, local escape offsets, bus y tracks/widths and three grounded shields. Geometry-derived4.5um pitch replaces4.8um; M3 endpoints/output equal spans/shield endpoints and symmetric M4 spines follow placements. Retain the four legal full-pad PFET-body M2 bridges at translated lanes.

layout.output_loads: The two ideal 5 fF loads belong only to the common simulation testbench, not GDS.

source.line_endings: Preserve exact CRLF bytes of the immutable published Git blob, without canonicalization.
source.nominal_resolution: Resolve only pair_skew=0; preserve every D/G/S/B, model, W/L, and m=1. The coarse-bank L is 1 um, not the prospective fine-bank lengths.

structural_gates.handoff: Report full 27-device DRC/LVS success or the first fundamental blocker to the coordinator before claiming simulation qualification.

extraction.units: Native ngspice() exports use bare micrometre W/L and square-micrometre junction areas. The shared testbench sets scale=1u exactly once. Reject incompatible explicit-SI or extra scale declarations. Audit actual ngspice device W/L, not just deck text.

physical_acceptance.area_definition: BBox of all nonempty GDS material polygons, excluding TEXT only

comparison_frozen_before_any_new_spice.environment: Existing Windows ngspice47 and already approved pinned models

numeric_acceptance.bounded_round_override: Apply unchanged10/5ps qualification; if unqualified, stop. No finer runs authorized.

comparison_frozen_before_any_new_spice.promotion: No new wrong/unresolved outcomes at either deadline; expose every timing/energy delta. Stop and do not promote on timing regression above 0.02ns or energy regression above 1%, or unqualified numerics. Area alone is not a PPA improvement; no full-grid replacement.

qualification: Archived RC-deck outcomes; model physical fidelity not yet qualified
